'''Green Four''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the fourth member of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Green Four.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]], [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Nichos Panib]] used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]].<ref name="SWI146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref>

[[4 ABY/Legends|One year later]], during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]] flew as Green Four, aiding [[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]] [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]] in disabling the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]<ref name="TEGtW" /> and following [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] into the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star's]] superstructure.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[6 ABY/Legends|Two and a half years]] after the Battle of Endor, [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] pilot [[Nawara Ven]] used the call sign Green Four in a simulation of the [[Redemption scenario|''Redemption'' scenario]] while training to qualify for membership in the reformed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="XWRS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Green Squadron (New Republic)|Green Team]] pilot participated in the [[Battle of Calamari]], struggling to shake pursuing [[TIE/D automated starfighter|droid TIE fighters]].<ref name="DEa" />
